up: Retrieve the distinct molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5728555. For each molecule, provide its ChEMBL identifier (molecule_chembl_id), its preferred name (pref_name), and its canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles) if available. Do not limit the number of rows returned.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728555';
